García-Quiroga et al. compare cuts, syrups and sugars for consumer acceptability and purchase intention and trained-panel sensory attributes; the publisher abstract reports no cognitive task, and cooked syrup differs from raw kiwi.
Monro 2013 review addresses kiwi composition, in vitro digestive diffusion and in vivo glycemic response; abstract reports no attention measure or Parkinson group.
